_doc: I/L Arch Mage line (spec #319, I2 #321), books 220/221/222. Each of I6-I10 owns one contiguous region and appends its entries there, so the parallel tickets never collide. I6 (#325): Cold Beam, Thunder Bolt, Teleport (moved from magician.json), Ice Strike, Thunder Spear. I7 (#326): Ice Demon, Element Composition (il). I8 (#327): Chain Lightning. I9 (#328): Ifrit. I10 (#329): Blizzard, Big Bang (il). Energy Bolt and Magic Claw stay in magician.json (F/P's pool entries too). Tier C cooldowns are the F/P base values x0.4 (GAME_DESIGN 7.60).

cold_beam._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.60.
cold_beam.name: Cold Beam
cold_beam.desc: Freezes the nearest monster with an icy beam.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster with a sharp piece of ice. The monster will freeze if hit. Fire-based monsters take 1.5 times the damage, ice-based monsters half.
text.h: Basic attack {mad}, mastery {mastery_pct}%, up to {count|monster|monsters}, freeze for {time} sec.

cold_beam._survivor: Tier C: nearest-target auto-cast, 0.5 s cooldown (1.25 s x0.4), 300 px range, one target, swingO1 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: hit/effect only (no ball), elemAttr i, mad/mastery and freeze time from the canonical level; no prop field, so every damaging hit attempts freeze through on_hit.

thunder_bolt._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.60.
thunder_bolt.name: Thunder Bolt

text.desc: Attacks surrounding monsters with a thunder bolt.

thunder_bolt._survivor: Tier C: auto-cast with at least one monster in the canonical box, 0.6 s cooldown (1.5 s x0.4), swingO1 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: lt/rb/mobCount, mad/mastery and elemAttr l from Skill.wz; hit/effect only (no ball).

teleport_il.name: Teleport
teleport_il.desc: Press X and a direction to blink to a platform. Hold X to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Teleport key with an arrow key to teleport a set distance to another platform in the same map. Hold the key to keep teleporting.

teleport_il._teleport: Tier C: 0.3 s survivor repeat delay; bot blinks from threats within 60 px. Canonical mpCon and range from Skill.wz. Same numbers as teleport_fp; the rank follows balance.mobility_rank_levels (the job's mobility_skill), so it has no cards.

ice_strike._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.60.
ice_strike.name: Ice Strike
ice_strike.desc: Freezes the monsters around you with a burst of ice.

text.desc: Strikes nearby monsters with a burst of ice. The monsters will freeze if hit. Fire-based monsters take 1.5 times the damage, ice-based monsters half.
text.h: Basic attack {mad}, mastery {mastery_pct}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}, freeze for {time} sec.

ice_strike._survivor: Tier C: auto-cast with at least one monster in the canonical box, 1.6 s cooldown (4 s x0.4), magic2 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: lt/rb/mobCount 6, mad/mastery, freeze time and elemAttr i from Skill.wz, action magic2; no prop field, so every damaging hit attempts freeze through on_hit; effect and hit/0 only (no ball), Use sound only.

thunder_spear._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.60.
thunder_spear.name: Thunder Spear
thunder_spear.desc: Spears the nearest monster with a heavy bolt of lightning.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster with a heavy spear of lightning. Ice-based monsters take 1.5 times the damage, lightning-based monsters half.

thunder_spear._survivor: Tier C: nearest-target auto-cast, 0.8 s cooldown (2 s x0.4), 400 px range, one target (the WZ node has no mobCount and no box), magic1 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: mad/mastery and elemAttr l from Skill.wz, action magic1; effect and hit/0 only (no ball), Use sound only.
